zh.title: 更直观的雷达、图层与地点操作
zh.summary: 本次更新让降水变化、地图图层和常用地点操作更加清晰顺手。

items.text: 新增降水雷达叠加，可直接在地图上查看雷达画面、时间和播放进度，并调节透明度。
新增启动图层偏好，可保留当前 Windy 图层，或在打开插件时切换到指定图层。
点击收藏对比中的地点名称即可切换位置，并自动将地点保持在可见地图区域。
可临时固定当前位置，避免查看地图时因误触而切换观测地点。
修复移动端事件面板、收藏界面和地图定位的多处交互问题。

en.title: More intuitive radar, layers, and location controls
en.summary: This update makes precipitation changes, map layers, and common location actions clearer and easier to use.

items.text: Added a precipitation radar overlay with frame time, playback progress, and adjustable opacity directly on the map.
Added a startup-layer preference to keep the current Windy layer or switch to a selected layer when the plugin opens.
Select a location name in Favorites comparison to switch locations and keep it centered in the visible map area.
Temporarily pin the current location to prevent accidental map taps from changing the observing point.
Fixed several mobile interaction issues in the Events panel, Favorites surfaces, and map positioning.
